finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: filename contains shell metacharacters or commands
finding.assumptions: The filename is directly used in a system call or command execution without proper sanitization.

parsed.change_summary: Added a loop to sanitize the filename by replacing shell metacharacters and whitespace with underscores.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked because the code now replaces shell metacharacters and whitespace in the filename with underscores, preventing them from being interpreted as part of a shell command.
parsed.behavior_changes: The behavior changes include the addition of filename sanitization, which replaces certain characters with underscores. This may affect filenames that contain these characters, but it prevents potential OS command injection vulnerabilities.

parsed.refutation_attempt: 1) Checked for any sanitization or validation before the ifstream call – none found. 2) Verified that ifstream(filename) simply opens a file using the OS file‑open API, not a shell command; thus no command injection vector exists. 3) Confirmed that the reported trigger (shell metacharacters) would have no effect on the file‑open operation. 4) Concluded that the finding is a false positive.
